label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform and Conversational AI, plus Uvation Pulse and Atlas CRM
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: All 35 AI-server listings are in production and disabled pending approval. A full catalogue re-check started on 29 Sep, due 30 Sep. Account hub moved to 4 of 10 subtasks done, RMA email templates and refund and exchange timelines closed, and the home page category and filter sections are done, all on 29 Sep. A new bug has the approved-quote email showing an unformatted total (MT-1539). 20 open items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Figma validation now has 56 defects, 23 fixed. A P1 bug on the new AI Factory pages (MR-1260) was raised on 29 Sep with 14 subtasks, one marked Blocker. Smoke regression, security and privacy test tasks were added the same day. The sitemap fix (MR-1199) has not started, so automation still covers 250 of 500+ URLs.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: The three S1 production bugs from 25 and 28 Sep (wrong AI Factory prices and a Document API 502) are still in To Do and due 30 Sep. Four UI bugs closed on 29 Sep, leaving 59 open bugs, 5 of them S1. The IAM security hardening story (9 subtasks) is in progress. Eight items are past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: Book a Meeting and its five subtasks closed on 29 Sep, 25 days after the 4 Sep due date, so nothing in the programme is past due. The CSM Teams dashboard (UC-215) is in testing, due 30 Sep. Eight agent stories are still in To Do with no due dates.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: The board was set up on 28 and 29 Sep: 8 epics, 64 stories, 256 subtasks and 1 bug, all held by Anshul Bhargava. 247 items were moved to In Progress within a day of creation, 6 of the 8 epics among them, and none are done. No item has a due date. Only 1.5 h is logged in Tempo, on PULSE-70 and the new telemetry-ingest bug PULSE-329, so the In Progress count does not reflect effort yet.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: One story, ATLAS-1 'R&D on CRM for MVP', created 28 Sep and held by Anshul Bhargava. It is still in To Do with no due date, and 2.75 h is logged against it (2 h on 28 Sep, 45 min on 29 Sep).
